definitions: To burn with an unsteady, flickering, or sudden bright flame.
To widen or spread outwards, especially at the end.
To become suddenly more intense or violent (of a fire, emotion, or conflict).
To display or show off ostentatiously.
examples: The match flared brightly before going out.
The skirt flared out at the bottom.
Tensions flared between the two groups.
He liked to flare his wealth.
